import math, numpy as np
from PIL import Image

def ground_pt(u, v, cam_x, cam_y, cam_yaw):
    H = 1.55
    d_fwd = H * 256.0 / (v - 256.0)
    d_right = H * (u - 256.0) / (v - 256.0)
    rad = math.radians(cam_yaw)
    wx = cam_x + d_fwd * math.sin(rad) + d_right * math.cos(rad)
    wy = cam_y + d_fwd * math.cos(rad) - d_right * math.sin(rad)
    return wx, wy

im22 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0022.png'))
# Restrict to table region: u < 350
m_tbl22 = (im22[:,:,0] > 100) & (im22[:,:,0] < 160) & (im22[:,:,1] > 40) & (im22[:,:,1] < 80) & (im22[:,:,2] < 35) & (im22[:,:,1] > im22[:,:,2]) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 310)

bottoms = {}
for u in range(180, 310):
    rows = np.argwhere(m_tbl22[:, u])
    if len(rows) > 0:
        bottoms[u] = rows.max()

import scipy.signal as sig
u_vals = list(bottoms.keys())
v_vals = [bottoms[u] for u in u_vals]
peaks, _ = sig.find_peaks(v_vals, distance=10)
for p in peaks:
    u = u_vals[p]
    v = v_vals[p]
    pt = ground_pt(u, v, 0.0303, 3.2803, 45.0)
    print(f"Table Leg at u={u}, v={v} -> ground pt: ({pt[0]:.2f}, {pt[1]:.2f})")

EOF
